contradicted: Three things were contradicted, one of them this lane's own premise and one of them the dispatch's. (1) Dispatch falsifier 1 is CONTRADICTED as worded: served zoned with retired rows excluded is 147,145 against a source of 167,064 — 88.05 percent, outside the +/-5 percent band — because the floor's operative predicate is a ratio (sourceZoned/servedZoned crossing 0.95, code line 551+554), not a count equality. Reading (a) survives on the ratio; the prediction was pre-registered in the wrong currency. (2) A-207's attribution is INVERTED: the retired R-prefixed rows are the source's own id keyspace (282,569 of 282,569 served R ids are source R ids, q18) and they DEFLATE the served count; the population the source never keys is the NUMERIC one (147,145 zoned, source holds 0 numeric prop_ids). (3) Reading (b) is FALSE: the bake reaches zoning for numeric nodes through the situs-address recovery join, and all five named parcels reach a district equal to the one they serve today, so nothing would be stripped. One thing NOT contradicted and stated so it is not buried: with the fix, the numeric population leaves the floor's comparison — recorded in the verdict, guarded elsewhere, and named in the residual above.

answerA.codePath: src/lib/publish-coverage-floor.mjs: SOURCE_ZONED_SQL counts txgio_parcel rows whose zoning column is non-blank (sourceZoned, sourceParcels) for the county; SERVED_ZONED_SQL counts place_layer_snapshots rows for adapter_key 'node-facets:tier1' whose payload_json->'zoning' is an object (servedZoned, servedTier1Rows). Neither side filters retired rows and neither side classifies ids, so the served side counts every id namespace the bake wrote while the source side counts only the namespace its table is keyed in. evaluateCoverageFloor then computes retention = sourceZoned / servedZoned (line 551) and refuses below MIN_COVERAGE_RETENTION 0.95 (line 554).
